value.name: analyze apartment rental options
value.description: She considers ways to rent out the third-floor apartment to generate income, including a separate entrance off the side alley.
evidence: There was a small-business arrangement under which the third-floor apartment, which she had noticed on her first visit had a separate entrance off the side alley, could be rented out to generate income.
There was, in short, work to do

value.name: begin making notes
value.description: She starts taking notes as she works through the financial and legal arrangements.

value.name: meet Marcus for lunch
value.description: On Tuesday, she has lunch with Marcus at their usual Sansom Street place and mostly listens while he talks about his life and work.
evidence: On Tuesday she had lunch with Marcus at the place on Sansom Street that they had been having lunch at for three years
and she listened to him more than she talked, which was what she had promised herself she would do
and what he said to her was mostly about other cases and about a partner who was retiring and about his daughter's college applications

value.name: Marcus praises her restraint
value.description: Over coffee, Marcus tells her she held the line by not having lunch with the woman.
evidence: only at the end, over coffee, did he say, "You held the line."
"You did not have lunch with her."
"I did not have lunch with her."

value.name: Marcus urges future lunch
value.description: Marcus tells her she should have lunch with the woman after the estate is closed and the structures are signed.
evidence: "You should," he said again. "After. When the estate is closed and the structures are signed and there is no longer any professional reason for you not to. You should have lunch with her. You are allowed. The rule exists for the duration of the representation. The rule does not exist for the rest of your life."

value.name: she hesitates about future contact
value.description: She responds uncertainly when Marcus presses her about whether she will have lunch with the woman after the matter is finished.
